Package planning

Interface Planner

All Known Implementing Classes:
AStarPlanner, BFSPlanner, DFSPlanner, DijkstraPlanner
public interface Planner
Interface representing a planner in an automated planning system. A planner generates a sequence of actions that transform an initial state into a state that satisfies a given goal. It provides methods to retrieve the initial state, available actions, and the goal to achieve.
